**What does the script do, and what does it change on the router?**


**Tested on RouterOS version(s):**

Checklist:
- [ ] One script per file in `scripts/`, with the header (name, description, author, tags, routeros)
- [ ] No passwords, keys, public IP addresses, e-mail addresses or client / site names
- [ ] Doesn't disable `www`, remove the `tikmanager` user or touch the `tikmanager` WireGuard interface
- [ ] Safe to run twice (or the description says why not)
